sources.citation: SIL International language page for zaq (www.sil.org/resources/search/language/zaq), Wayback capture 2015-09-07: full list of 18 SIL archive items for Aloápam Zapotec
sources.note: Inventory only: readers, riddles, number book, alphabet charts, vowel colouring book, the 2-page Ortografía (2001), two picture dictionaries. No grammar, phonology sketch or dictionary with grammar notes exists in the SIL archive list for zaq.

sources.citation: Radin, Paul. 1925. The distribution and phonetics of the Zapotec dialects: a preliminary sketch. Journal de la Société des Américanistes 17: 27-76. [Glottolog ref 103699]
sources.note: Lists 'Aloapa' among the Serrano pueblos ('All the puebloes in this group form a fixed unit with the exception of Abejones, Aloapa and Xia', p.30) and says of Zapotec generally 'The vowels are characterized by the possession of pitch accent' (p.31) and mentions 'loss of old pitch accent' (p.34); no statement on where word stress falls in any variety, and no Aloápam-specific phonetic remarks.

sources.citation: Bibliographic database searches for 'Aloápam/Aloapam': Lingmex (El Colegio de México), Dialnet, CIESAS institutional repository, CrossRef, OpenAIRE, DOAJ, Zenodo, archive.org full catalogue, Persée; Glottolog 5.1 sources.bib grep
sources.note: Zero linguistic works on Aloápam Zapotec beyond the SIL literacy items and Radin 1925. (Google/Bing/Scholar, SIL search pages, HathiTrust, OLAC, Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex and Google Books were blocked or rate-limited from our machine.)

sources.citation: Ca Tisa gue Tata Jesucristuha: El Nuevo Testamento, zapoteco de Aloápam. 1a ed. 2020, Wycliffe Bible Translators; versión electrónica 2022 (scriptureearth.org). 724 pp.
sources.note: No alphabet or pronunciation preface/appendix (checked front matter, back matter and full-text grep for acento/alfabeto/pronuncia). The practical orthography marks an acute accent on some vowels (sitá, bilátia, Gualíba, esíaya, carbáru), implying accent is written where not default, but no rule is stated.

sources.citation: Valverde V., Marilyn (asesora lingüística). 2013. El alfabeto en el zapoteco de Aloápam (hojas). Versión electrónica. Instituto Lingüístico de Verano. 39 pp. [SIL archive 52842]
sources.note: Nothing. One letter/digraph per page with a keyword and picture (a, aa, a'a, b, c, ch, d, dh, e, ee, e'e,... x, xx, y, yy); no notes on accent or tone.

sources.citation: Valverde V., Marilyn (comp.). 2007. Diccionario ilustrado en el zapoteco de Aloápam. 2a ed. México, D.F.: Instituto Lingüístico de Verano. 26 pp. [SIL archive 12922; Glottolog ref 87889]
sources.note: Nothing. Image-only picture dictionary arranged by semantic field; one-page Introducción about purpose only; no alphabet, tone or accent note. Orthography writes acute accents on some vowels (rixú, númiru, xbiná, nári) without explanation.
